023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper.djl;
024
025import com.google.inject.Inject;
026import com.google.inject.Singleton;
027import org.opt4j.core.start.Constant;
028
029import java.io.BufferedWriter;
030import java.io.FileWriter;
031import java.io.IOException;
032import java.util.ArrayList;
033import java.util.List;
034import java.util.logging.Logger;
035
036@Singleton
037public class GatekeeperMetricsTracker implements AutoCloseable {
038
039    private static final Logger log = Logger.getLogger(GatekeeperMetricsTracker.class.getName());
040
041    private final List<Float> accuracyHistory = new ArrayList<>();
042    private final List<Float> fpHistory = new ArrayList<>();
043    private final List<Float> fnHistory = new ArrayList<>();
044    private final List<Integer> evaluationHistory = new ArrayList<>();
045    private final List<Integer> iterationHistory = new ArrayList<>();
046
047    private final int averageWindow = 50;
048
049    private String accuracyFilename = "accuracy.tsv";
050
051    /**
052     * Sets the file the metrics are written to on {@link #close()}.
053     *
054     * @param accuracyFilename
055     *            the output file
056     */
057    @Inject(optional = true)
058    void setAccuracyFilename(
059            @Constant(value = "accuracyFilename", namespace = org.opt4j.gatekeeper.NeuralGatekeeperModule.class) String accuracyFilename) {
060        this.accuracyFilename = accuracyFilename;
061    }
062
063    public synchronized void recordBatchMetrics(long tp, long tn, long fp, long fn, int currentIteration, int evaluatedCount) {
064        long totalSamples = tp + tn + fp + fn;
065        if (totalSamples == 0) return;
066
067        float accuracy = (float) (tp + tn) / totalSamples;
068        long negatives = fp + tn;
069        float fpr = (negatives > 0) ? (float) fp / negatives : 0.0f;
070        long positives = fn + tp;
071        float fnr = (positives > 0) ? (float) fn / positives : 0.0f;
072
073        accuracyHistory.add(accuracy);
074        fpHistory.add(fpr);
075        fnHistory.add(fnr);
076        evaluationHistory.add(evaluatedCount);
077        iterationHistory.add(currentIteration);
078    }
079
080    @Override
081    public synchronized void close() {
082        try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(accuracyFilename))) {
083            writer.write("Iteration\tEvaluations\tPredictor\tAccuracy\tFPR\tFNR\n");
084
085            int size = accuracyHistory.size();
086            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
087                writer.write(iterationHistory.get(i) + "\t" +
088                        evaluationHistory.get(i) + "\tNeuralNet\t" +
089                        accuracyHistory.get(i) + "\t" +
090                        fpHistory.get(i) + "\t" +
091                        fnHistory.get(i) + "\n");
092            }
093            log.info("Gatekeeper metrics saved to " + accuracyFilename);
094        } catch (IOException e) {
095            log.warning("Error writing accuracy log: " + e.getMessage());
096        }
097    }
098}
